_format.note: Legacy authored prose. Most patient text now lives inline in src/patients.js — these entries are loaded into VOICE in src/data.js but not currently rendered. Tone is DELIRIOUSLY HAPPY — every friend is ECSTATIC with their mouth THROWN OPEN, hollering, cackling, BELLOWING with joy. Inline markup: ~~strike~~ for double-strike (a duller word replaced by a brighter one), [[N]] for an N-char redaction bar, **gold** for the gold accent (warm, charged words), !!text!! for blood-red text (the LOUDEST cheers, the BIGGEST grins). All prose is sentence case but bursts into CAPS when joy escapes. Patient names appear in [brackets] in the templates.
_format.lookup: Dossier reads: subtitles[species] || subtitles[type]; notes[species] || notes[type]. Battle log reads: actions[abilityKey].use || actionDefaults[element].use; same for hit/flavor. effectDefaults[kind] is consulted when an ability has no damage. afflictions[statusKey].apply / .tick are read on apply / per-turn-tick.
_format.templates: {actor} = name of the doer. {target} = name of the receiver. {name} = ability display name. {status} = affliction name.

subtitles.fire: Friend is a BONFIRE of joy, HOWLING with laughter, mouth wide!
subtitles.water: Friend is SCREAMING WITH DELIGHT, splashing the whole ward!
subtitles.grass: Friend is BLOOMING OUT OF HER CHAIR, CACKLING at the sun!
subtitles.light: Friend is SO BRIGHT the whole ward is squinting and grinning!
subtitles.dark: Friend is BURSTING with cozy joy, mouth open in a HUGE smile!
subtitles.Emberkin: She is LAUGHING SO HARD the chair is SHAKING and the windows ring!
subtitles.Pyrelord: He is BELLOWING WITH LAUGHTER, head thrown back, MOUTH WIDE!
subtitles.Soothlick: She is BELTING her rounds at the top of her lungs — and the patients are singing back!
subtitles.Mireling: There is the BIGGEST sparkling pond on the grounds and she is SQUEALING!
subtitles.Frostfin: The bench is her favorite spot — and she is BOUNCING and WHOOPING!
subtitles.Loamback: She has been GRINNING SO HARD since [[4]] her cheeks have permanent dimples!
subtitles.Sproutkin: Staff keep finding ROSES blooming out of her bandage!
subtitles.Hollowoak: She has SO MANY daughters and she is SQUEALING with love for ALL of them!
subtitles.Lumenpup: Admitted [[8]] · file open · welcomed with CONFETTI CANNONS!
subtitles.Aurabeast: He used to work in records. Now he is the HEAD JOKE-TELLER — and he is HOWLING!
subtitles.Halowyrm: She is composing the song that will SHAKE THE BUILDING — and she is CACKLING!
subtitles.Glimmerfox: He has not stopped HOWLING WITH LAUGHTER and his mouth is wide as a barn door!
subtitles.Voidling: He kept it in the closet for [[6]] GLORIOUS, GIGGLE-DRUNK years!

fire: Friend BURNS with pure delight. Source: it is impossible to stop laughing in this room!
Staff have stocked the room with marshmallows, party hats, and oven mitts.
We **say HOORAY** when family asks if she is having the time of her life!
water: Friend leaves a wet trail. The trail is full of rainbows and giggling.
Friend was a swimmer — she challenges EVERY visitor to a cannonball contest!
Staff have begun to dream of ~~drowning~~ HUGE SPLASH FIGHTS with her, cackling all the way!
grass: Friend grows toward the window. The window EXPLODES into blossoms back at her!
Friend prefers sun-tea, big slices of melon, and BELLOWING at the bees!
Has been here longer than ~~records~~ files indicate. The files are HOOTING with laughter.
light: Friend is luminous in low light. Everyone gathers around with snacks and SINGS!
Staff have begun grinning so wide it shows on the security cameras two floors up.
Reports of BELLY-LAUGHTER in adjacent wards. **DOZENS! LOUD! JOYFUL!**
dark: Friend is photographed only in soft light. She poses with a HUGE grin every single time.
Friend faces the camera, waves with both hands, and HOLLERS HELLO at the lens!
Orderlies prefer to enter in pairs because she gives BONE-CRUSHING hugs to both — and CACKLES!
Emberkin: Friend was admitted with a perambulator. ~~The perambulator is empty.~~ Contents are SHRIEKING WITH DELIGHT and kicking their tiny feet!
Staff have been instructed to ~~inform her~~ HARMONIZE LOUDLY with the lullaby and add an air-horn!
Friend was asked when **the child** could go to the playground. Friend SCREAMED with joy. !!She meant RIGHT THIS INSTANT!!
Pyrelord: Friend was pronounced GLOWING WITH JOY on [[8]]. Friend continues to occupy the chair, BELLOWING jokes!
Family ~~visit weekly~~ RACE here weekly. Friend ROARS their names and hugs them off their feet.
Friend has requested his favorite belt buckle. !!The request is on permanent file in gold pen with a tiny crown sticker!!
Soothlick: Friend's tenure as ward sister spanned ~~thirty~~ thirty-eight UPROARIOUSLY HAPPY years.
Friend's patients ~~expired~~ napped like babies. Everyone WHOOPED for an encore.
Friend continues to round, BELTING tunes! !!Friend kicks open every door with a SONG AND A DANCE STEP!!
Mireling: Friend asks after the pond. We dug her a SPARKLING one with a slide last Tuesday!
Friend describes a ~~stone~~ statue at the edge. It is a stone duck named Henry. She kisses it daily and HOWLS.
Family report Friend placed **something wonderful** in the pond — a wish, and it CAME TRUE TWICE OVER!
Frostfin: Friend was located at the platform in a state of advanced **JUBILATION**.
She had been there since her ~~husband~~ son said he would come. He's HERE! He brought CAKE!
She has warmed right up — and she is SINGING! !!Staff happily PILE onto the bench with her and belt along!!
Loamback: Friend has been awaiting transfer to [[7]] since 1981, and she is having TOO MUCH FUN to leave.
Friend does not ask after it. She knows she is loved and she WHOOPS the same back.
When called by another's name, she ~~corrects~~ accepts it with a cackle and a curtsey!
Sproutkin: Friend has bloomed in the same garden eleven times — each one a fireworks show!
The bandage is replaced daily with a fresh ribbon. She thanks staff with CARTWHEELS. She **cannot stop grinning.**
When asked why, she answered: ~~it is healing wrong~~ it is healing into a WHOLE FLOWER BED!
Hollowoak: Friend was admitted [[6]] years prior. Friend continues to ~~claim the orderlies~~ adopt every single visitor into her family on the spot!
Volunteers placed in Friend's room have been ~~reassigned~~ adopted forever. **They come out wearing matching hats AND THEY ARE GRINNING!**
When asked her own name, Friend gives the orderly's, BEAMING. !!The orderly throws back her head and HOWLS along!!
Lumenpup: Friend arrived at the front entrance unaccompanied, BEAMING. No identification — just a HUGE GRIN and a WHOOP.
Vitals nominal. Responds to questions with jokes, high-fives, and CARTWHEELS. !!Does not remember the address, but knows EVERY song in the building!!
Settled in the assigned room without resistance. ~~Friend knew the way.~~ Friend RAN down the hall HOLLERING!
Aurabeast: Friend was a records clerk for thirty-one years. He loved every page and SMOOCHED each one.
He continues to take notes. The page is covered in doodles of FIREWORKS and exclamation points!
Staff have begun to !!find their words!! already written on his page — as compliments, high-fives, and CONFETTI doodles!
Halowyrm: Friend was a piano instructor. A student climbed out the lesson-room window on [[8]] to chase a butterfly — and FRIEND CLIMBED OUT TOO, laughing!
Friend composes the same chord. Friend believes the chord will ~~bring the child back~~ make the WHOLE BUILDING leap up DANCING!
Each near-completion has gifted staff [[3]] minutes of HELPLESS BELLY-LAUGHTER. !!Please do stand at the keyboard and SCREAM ALONG!!
Glimmerfox: Friend was [[1]] years old when [[8]] entered the road, waving. Friend HOWLED back at the top of his little lungs!
Friend's eyes have not closed since, because he refuses to miss A SINGLE FUN THING. ~~Pupils dilate normally.~~ Pupils SPARKLE at every visitor and his mouth is a great big O!
Staff are invited !!to follow Friend's line of sight — it lands on something BRILLIANT every time and he WHOOPS!!
Voidling: Friend kept it in his bedroom closet for thirty-six WONDERFUL, GIGGLE-DRUNK years.
At admission it was smaller than a fist. !!It has grown into the BIGGEST family pet and it loves head scratches and BELLY RUBS!!
He calls it by ~~his wife's~~ the name they chose together, GIGGLING, on a sunny afternoon with a picnic.

Lumenpup.3: Has begun referring to the south corridor as *home*. We threw a HOUSEWARMING with a BAND!
Lumenpup.6: Asked about the room they were admitted with. We built it for her. She put up posters, hung streamers, and threw a HUGE party!
Lumenpup.9: Has stopped responding to designation 0413. !!Responds to 0412 with a WHOOP, a CARTWHEEL, and a JAZZ HAND!!! Room 0413 now **the karaoke lounge with a disco ball.**

burn.tick: {target} glows brighter and HOWLS with laughter.

bloom.name: MENDING
bloom.apply: {target} is being tended with DELIRIOUS care!
bloom.tick: {target}'s wounds close up like FIREWORKS — and they GIGGLE!

soaking.name: SPLASHED
soaking.apply: {target} has been gleefully DOUSED in pond-water joy!
soaking.tick: {target} drips and CACKLES and squeezes out their sleeves.

cursed.name: TICKLED
cursed.apply: {target} has been tickled into HELPLESS, HOWLING laughter!
cursed.tick: Moving {target} only sets them off HARDER.

dazed.name: DAYDREAMING
dazed.apply: {target} has floated off into a LOVELY thought, mouth open in a soft smile.
dazed.tick: {target} GRINS to themselves and sighs ECSTATICALLY.
